title: In Memoriam: Barry Steinhardt
content:
Barry Steinhardt, a lifelong privacy champion and an early leader in the battle for digital civil liberties who served as EFF’s president in 1998-99, died last week at age 73. 

A Connecticut native, Steinhardt led the Vermont and Pennsylvania affiliates of the American Civil Liberties Union before becoming associate director of the national ACLU. There, he helped spearhead the fight to overturn much of the Communications Decency Act, resulting in the U.S. Supreme Court’s landmark Reno v. ACLU ruling in 1997. 

When the internet was still young, Steinhardt became one of the first attorneys to specialize in the intersection of technology and privacy. In early 1998 he took a leave of absence from the ACLU to become EFF’s president, and then returned to the ACLU in 1999. 

In 2002 he founded the ACLU’s Program on Technology and Liberty. After retiring from the ACLU, he continued on as a senior advisor to London-based Privacy International.

title: Nidal Hasan’s Public Execution Is Off, But Propagandists Are Still Using Him as a Martyr
content:
Last week, Secretary of War Pete Hegseth announced the Pentagon would livestream the execution of convicted killer Nidal Hasan. Today, Trump said the execution would move forward but that it wouldn’t be livestreamed. But the propaganda damage is already done. Experts who watch terrorist spaces online told 404 Media that Hasan is already turning up in memes, videos, and recruitment material for groups like Al Qaeda.

Hasan—a former US Army Major who had once attempted to contact Al Qaeda—killed 13 people and injured 32 others at Fort Hood in 2009. He was shot and captured at the scene and later sentenced to death. Hegseth’s plan to livestream Hasan’s execution and the furor around it brought Hasan and his crimes back into the spotlight 17 years later. Hasan has mostly been a forgotten figure in Islamist and extremist circles, but is now once again a fixture of their propaganda.

“It's already started,” Moustafa Ayad, research chair in global Islamism and counter-terrorism at the Institute for Strategic Dialogue, told 404 Media. “We're already seeing edited videos in support of Nidal Hasan, and they're specifically based around how he's a martyr and that his legacy lives on.”

title: KI in der Migrationsverwaltung: Keine Experimente mit den Daten von Migrant*innen und klare Grenzen für KI-Systeme
content:
Der Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) im Migrationskontext ist nicht neu: Seit zehn Jahren setzt das Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge (BAMF) bereits KI-Technologien ein. Doch nun will die Bundesregierung mit einem neuen Gesetzentwurf die Automatisierung im Migrationsbereich pauschal erweitern. Auf der Suche nach effizienteren Verwaltungsprozessen ignoriert das Gesetz zum Einsatz Künstlicher Intelligenz in der Migrationsverwaltung (KIMVG) die nötigen Voraussetzungen für eine faire Anwendung von KI‑Systemen. Statt klare Grenzen für den Einsatzkontext und konkrete Angaben für die technischen Voraussetzungen zu formulieren, setzt der Entwurf auf einen weiten Spielraum. Eklatante Risiken, insbesondere die drohenden Einschränkungen bei fairen Verfahren für Menschen, die Asyl oder Visa beantragen, werden in Kauf genommen oder nicht ausreichend adressiert.

AlgorithmWatch empfiehlt deshalb:

  • Änderungen an § 7 AsylG und § 86 AufenthG streichen: Keine KI-Entwicklung anhand von personenbezogenen Daten von Menschen aus dem Migrationsbereich
  • Die Weitergabe von personenbezogenen Daten an Dritte ausschließen
  • Effektive Maßnahmen gegen diskriminierende Algorithmen definieren

title: Leena Leppänen has been awarded the title of Docent at the Arctic Centre
content:
15.10.2026

  • Share on FaceBook
  • Share on LinkedIn

    • Visiting Researcher | Arctic Centre, University of Lapland

    Leena Leppänen, Doctor of Philosophy, has been awarded the title of Docent at the Arctic Centre of the University of Lapland starting November 1, 2026. The title of Docent is given in the field of Snow Physics.

    Leppänen’s research focuses on snow physics, snow microstructure, and snow measurements. She possesses extensive, over a decade long professional experience in snow research. She has done snow measurements in Lapland, Switzerland, Iceland, Svalbard, and Antarctica. Leppänen’s current research concerns the effects of water falling onto a snow surface, such as the changes in the snow microstructure.

    Leppänen received her doctorate in geophysics from the University of Helsinki in 2020. Her doctoral thesis investigated the measurement and modeling of seasonal snowpack properties using passive microwave observations.

title: Satellite Images Show Extent of Trump Admin’s Tree-Felling at DC Golf Course
content:
Sign up here to receive Bellingcat’s biggest investigations by email as soon as they are published.

Satellite imagery obtained by Bellingcat lays bare the extent of tree-felling at a Washington DC golf course that President Trump is reportedly seeking to transform into a championship-level course, despite moves to protect the site by conservationists. 

The extent and circumstances surrounding the rapid changes prompted a judge to call an emergency hearing earlier this week, banning any further changes until later this month.

Reports on Wednesday detailed that 430 trees were cut down at the East Potomac Golf Links  which is owned by the Federal government and managed by the National Park Service (NPS). This is despite a judge reportedly stating earlier this year that no more than 10 trees at the course could be cut down without first notifying the court. 

NPR reported that officials notified the court just before 5pm on Friday Oct. 9 of plans to remove up to 529 trees in phases starting  the next day on Saturday Oct. 10. That prompted US District Court Judge Ana Reyes to call an emergency hearing on Oct. 12. By that time, 430 trees had reportedly been cut down.

title: COP17: Tracking progress towards the UN’s 2030 nature targets
content:
Countries will meet in Armenia this month to carry out the first global review of progress towards meeting key nature targets by 2030.

These targets – and the wider ambition to halt and reverse biodiversity loss around the world – were agreed in the landmark Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework in 2022.

But the ambitions will not be achieved in time for the 2030 deadline unless action “accelerates rapidly”, a key UN report found.

It noted that nations are falling short on 22 of 23 nature targets, which focus on restoring ecosystems, increasing nature finance and reducing harmful subsidies.

This report and other findings will inform the global progress review taking place at the COP17 biodiversity summit in Armenia over 19-30 October.

The sections below summarise the report’s findings on where progress has – and has not – been made on each of the 23 targets.

They also rank the extent to which countries have addressed elements of each target on a national basis. Click on each target for more information. Key terms are defined throughout each section and in a glossary below.

title: Dodging Russian Drones on Europe’s Highway to Hell
content:
Europe’s longest road, the E-40, begins its 5,000-mile journey at the port of Calais, long the gateway to the British Isles, and ends in the Altai Mountains of Kazakhstan.

It’s part of the E-road system, which aims to help unite Europe in trade and to aid development and ties between neighbors; until 2014, it was doing just that. Now, when you drive about 2,000 miles along the route, you come upon strange and otherworldly sights signaling your arrival at a battlefield, the key sector for Ukraine’s desperate fight to repel the Russian invader.

This summer I drove twice from the UK to the fortress belt with volunteers delivering aid to the defenders.

We entered the Channel Tunnel at Folkestone and emerged in Calais to take the E-40 across France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, Poland, and Ukraine all the way to a crossroads at Slovyansk where the road becomes impassable as it peels off toward Russian-occupied Bakhmut.

Going right at that crossroads leads 13 miles to Kramatorsk, and then it’s 22 miles further to Kostyantynivka, another battlefield frustrating Putin’s plans.

title: Silmänpohjakuvantamisesta okulomiikkaan: tekoäly, data ja teknologia avaavat uuden ikkunan terveyteen ja suomalaiselle terveysteknologialle
content:
Vanhan sanonnan mukaan silmät ovat sielun peili. Sanonta on varmasti jossain määrin totta, vaikka sielun olemassaolon tieteellinen todistaminen ja määritelmä on toistaiseksi vielä työn alla. Toinen on asian laita, jos vaihdamme sanan sielu tilalle terveys, niin olemme lääketieteellisen läpimurron äärellä nimeltä okulomiikka.

Ymmärtääksemme miksi okulomiikka voi tulevaisuudessa muuttaa lääketiedettä ja terveydenhuoltoa, meidän on aloitettava silmän anatomiasta, silmäsairauksista ja niiden vaikutuksesta nykyhetken terveydenhuoltoon.

Ihmisen silmä on yksi kehomme kehittyneimmistä elimistä: kehityksellisesti se on keskushermostomme jatke, joka kykenee ottamaan vastaan valoa ja muuttamaan sen sähköisiksi signaaleiksi, jotka aivomme tulkitsevat näöksi.  Silmä on ainoa paikka kehossamme, jossa verisuonia ja hermokudosta voidaan tarkastella suoraan, non-invasiivisesti. Silmänpohjakuvaus ja valokerroskuvaus eli OCT voivat siksi paljastaa muutoksia, jotka liittyvät paitsi silmäsairauksiin myös muualla kehossa esiintyviin sairauksiin.

title: Pohjoisen jäämeren datakaapelireitti edistäisi mannerten välistä tietoliikennettä
content:
Polar Connect -hanke selvittää mahdollisuuksia rakentaa arktinen merikaapeliyhteys Euroopan, Pohjois-Amerikan ja Aasian välille. Mahdollinen tulevaisuuden yhteys voisi vahvistaa kansainvälistä tietoliikennettä, tukea tutkimusyhteistyötä ja parantaa digitaalisen infrastruktuurin resilienssiä.

Retkikunnan keskeinen tehtävä oli kartoittaa mahdollista kaapelireittiä ja arvioida, millaisia teknisiä, operatiivisia ja ympäristöön liittyviä haasteita arktisen merikaapelin rakentamiseen liittyy. Laipion mukaan yksi tärkeimmistä havainnoista oli, että yhteys on teknisesti toteuttamiskelpoinen.

”Yksi tärkeimmistä havainnoista oli se, että monet aiemmin haasteina pidetyt asiat liittyen tietoliikennekaapeleiden operoimiseen arktisilla alueilla ovat ratkaistavissa oikein suunnitelluilla toimintamalleilla.”

Vaikka hanke on teknisesti mahdollinen, tuo ympäristö mukanaan omat haasteensa. Tutkimusmatka konkretisoi retkikunnalle, miten vaativissa olosuhteissa arktisella alueella työskennellään.

”Vaikuttavinta oli ehkä hetki, jolloin pääsimme kävelemään merijään päälle. Siinä konkretisoitui ensimmäistä kertaa, missä oikeasti olimme ja millaiseen ympäristöön hanketta suunnitellaan.”

title: "Hyperscale": Paris Marx on Excess of Big Tech Data Empires & His Critique of Bernie Sanders' AI Bill
content:
We speak with tech journalist Paris Marx about his new book, Hyperscale: The Ambition and Excess of Big Tech’s Data Empires. In the book, Marx exposes the deceptive ways tech companies are taking resources from vulnerable communities in order to build massive AI data centers. “We have seen the tech companies that, back in 2019, 2020, wanted us to see them as climate leaders … completely throw their targets out the window in order to pursue generative AI and this data center buildout,” says Marx. He notes that after failing to connect to electrical grids in the locations where they were building data centers, some AI companies have pivoted to building “on-site gas plants,” further increasing dependency on fossil fuels.

Tech companies “want us to believe” that AI models are “starting to become so powerful that within 10 years they could decide that they want to wipe out humanity or a significant chunk of humanity,” says Marx. “That is a mix of science fiction and delusion … and it is also a very effective way to distract from the real harms that we’re seeing from these generative AI products.”

title: Tutkija: Ruotsin hallitusjumi jatkuu – tuskin oikeistokaan saa kabinettia kasaan
content:
Ruotsissa hallitustunnustelut ovat edelleen pahassa juntturassa Magdalena Anderssonin epäonnisten yritysten jälkeen. Tutkija arvelee, ettei edellinen pääministeri Ulf Kristerssonkaan saisi palapelia kasaan yhtään paremmin.

Valtiopäivät hylkäsi torstaina odotetusti puhemies Andreas Norlénin ehdotuksen demarien keskenään muodostamasta hallituksesta, jonka pääministeri olisi Magdalena Andersson. Vain sosiaalidemokraatit äänestivät ehdotuksen puolesta, ja se kaatui äänin 248-99.

Koska Andersson ei aiemmin saanut muita puolueita kimppaan kanssaan, todennäköisesti hallituksen muodostajan tehtävä siirtyy väistyvälle pääministerille, maltillisen kokoomuksen Ulf Kristerssonille.

RUOTSIN politiikkakenttää tunteva Åbo Akademin valtio-opin professori Kimmo Grönlund piti torstaista äänestystä outona.

Hän arvelee puhemiehen ajatelleen, että pääministeristä täytyy äänestää ainakin kerran ennen hallituksen muodostajan vaihtamista.

Grönlund pitää epätodennäköisenä, että Kristerssonkaan onnistuisi tehtävässä.

- Ei se täysin poissuljettua ole, mutta on se kuitenkin epätodennäköisempää kuin että Andersson muodostaisi tai että tulisi uudet vaalit, Grönlund sanoo STT:lle.

title: Study Reveals How the European Parliament Uses Fear in Its Climate Communication
content:
Monika Brusenbauch Meislová, an associate professor in the Department of International Relations and European Studies at Masaryk University, examined the European Parliament’s communication during its 9th parliamentary term, from 2019 to 2024. Her study focused on the Parliament’s press releases and posts on X.

“The European Parliament presents itself as an active, responsible and necessary institution that offers solutions, and fear plays a fairly prominent role in building this image,” Brusenbauch Meislová told Update EU.

In 219 of the 235 press releases analysed, there were references to the Parliament’s self-legitimization as a climate actor. More than half of those releases also used fear. On X, fear appeared in approximately one in every seven posts.

The author identified three main narratives in the study. The first is a narrative of urgency, which presents the situation as a crisis requiring immediate action. The second is a narrative of loss, which draws attention to what has already been irretrievably lost or what could still be lost. The third is a narrative of danger, which emphasises future threats and the negative consequences of climate change.

title: Our Lawsuit Against the Trump Administration’s Social Media Surveillance Moves Forward. Here’s What the Court Said.

And just this month, we won our first major ruling: A federal district court denied the government’s motion to dismiss our lawsuit. This means the case can move forward—a win for free speech and a critical step in protecting our First Amendment rights online. title: Tutkimus: Suomi24-verkkoyhteisön keskustelut väestörakenteen muutoksista poikkeavat tilastojen todellisuudesta
content:
Kansalaisten verkkokeskustelut ja tilastojen todellisuus poikkeavat huomattavasti toisistaan, kun kyseessä ovat väestörakenteen muutokseen liittyvät ilmiöt, kuten maahanmuutto. Vaikka Suomen väestörakenteessa on tapahtunut isojakin murroksia, nousee Suomi24-keskustelupalstalle usein sytykkeitä aivan eri syistä kuin tilastot antaisivat olettaa. Tuoreen tutkimuksen mukaan esimerkiksi syntyvyyden jyrkkää laskua ei hahmoteta pitkän aikavälin ilmiönä. Maahanmuuttokeskustelut puolestaan keskittyvät voimakkaasti turvapaikanhakuun, turvallisuuteen ja sosiaalitukiin eikä verkkokeskusteluissa juurikaan käsitellä maahanmuuton taloudellisia hyötyjä.

Tilastojen suuret väestöilmiöt, kuten syntyvyyden jyrkkä lasku tai ennätyksellinen nettomaahanmuutto, eivät näytä heijastuvan suoraan kansalaisten keskusteluihin Suomi24-keskustelupalstalla. Etlan julkaisemasta tuoreesta tutkimuksesta käy ilmi, että sosiaalisessa mediassa väestöilmiöt tai suoranaiset sokit nousevat pinnalle usein muun kuohunnan ”oheistuotteena”- ja toisinaan aivan eri syistä kuin tilastot antaisivat olettaa.

title: TIEDOTE: Sukellusaluksen pienoismalli palaa Rosenlew-museoon
content:
Rosenlew-museossa esillä oleva Syvällä / pinnalla – meritekniikkaa Mäntyluodosta -näyttely täydentyy lokakuussa MIR-sukellusaluksen pienoismallilla. Rosenlew-museon kokoelmiin kuuluva esine on ollut lainassa Tampereella Emil Aaltosen museossa.

Rauma-Repolan Lokomon tehtaan valmistamien sukellusalusten rakennusvaihetta ja koesukellusmatkoja esittelevä näyttely on viimeistä päivää esillä Emil Aaltosen museossa Tampereella sunnuntaina 18.10.2026. Jo seuraavalla viikolla 20.10. pienoismalli tuodaan Poriin. Rosenlew-museossa se saa suunnitellusti paikan Mäntyluodon meritekniikkaa esittelevässä näyttelyssä.

Rauma-Repola valmisti kaksi pienoissukellusvenettä Neuvostoliiton tiedeakatemialle merenpohjantutkimusta varten. Alukset toimitettiin Neuvostoliittoon joulukuussa 1987. Kylmän sodan aikaiset vastakkainasettelut lännen ja idän välillä johtivat siihen, että aiotusta sukellusvenekaupasta tuli ulkopoliittinen kriisi. Rauma-Repolan ylin johto joutui käymään asiasta neuvotteluja USA:ssa. Lopputuloksena oli, että yhtiö sai toimittaa Neuvostoliittoon kaksi MIR-alusta, mutta siihen päättyi niiden tuotanto.

title: Vilnius Freedom Summit Unites Democratic Leaders and Activists Across Regions
content:
Vilnius, Lithuania—Freedom House and the Lithuanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs co-hosted the Vilnius Freedom Summit today, bringing together senior government officials, Nobel Peace Prize laureates, former political prisoners, and democracy advocates to strengthen international cooperation in confronting authoritarian threats. Hosted at Lithuania’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the summit emphasized the urgent need for greater coordination among democracies as authoritarian governments increasingly work together to suppress dissent and undermine democratic institutions.

“The desire for freedom is universal, and those standing up to authoritarian rule face many of the same challenges, regardless of where they live,” said Jamie Fly, CEO of Freedom House. “Lithuania, with its own history of overcoming Soviet occupation and longstanding tradition of solidarity with those fighting for freedom, was a fitting place to bring frontline activists from Central and Eastern Europe and Latin America together with policymakers, to strengthen cooperation and support one another in this shared struggle.”

title: Peru’s Indigenous people in Cutivireni and Oviri take the front line against Amazon wildfires
content:
Indigenous guardians play a critical role in protecting the land, their homes, and their livelihoods

Originally published on Global Voices

The Cool Earth initiative in Cutivireni and Oviri works around three key concepts: the monitoring of satellite fire weather alerts, the introduction of a flag-based system regarding safe times to conduct traditional fire practices, and practical training to contain small blazes and prevent them from causing devastation to the Indigenous people in the rainforest. Photo by Cool Earth, 2026; used with permission.

It’s September and 2026 has already been defined by wildfires spanning across the globe. Driven by the heat and dryness of the climate crisis, outbursts on the edge of Bordeaux, France have forced 200,000 from their homes and led to deaths in Spain. Smoke has billowed across the Canada-U.S. border, covering cities in smog.

Fires are expected to continue as seasons transition in the Southern Hemisphere, with a severe El Niño phenomenon that the United Nations warns will add pressure to an already scorching globe, risking similar conditions to those that — back in 2024 — drove the worst Amazonian wildfires in two decades.

title: How authoritarian states are building an international market for digital surveillance
content:
The main danger of AI in authoritarian regimes is the ability to suppress any protest

Originally published on Global Voices Advox

Moscow subway cameras are connected to a facial recognition system. Screenshot taken from the YouTube video “Facial recognition cameras help detain dissidents in the Moscow metro” by the DW YouTube channel; fair use.

Sonya, from Stavropol Krai, Russia, is 15 years old. In June 2026, she was sentenced to 70 hours of compulsory labor, connected to a February 2026 incident in which she had written the surname “Navalny” on a bus stop. That stop happened to be in a district that was being monitored by officers from the Center for Combating Extremism, commonly called Center E. Similarly, Yuri, a pensioner from Astrakhan who was also identified from surveillance footage, was given three years of restricted freedom for writing “No to War” in red marker on buildings.

title: Löytyykö biisisi tunnistamattomista soittotapahtumista?
content:

title: Abusive Care Facility in Thailand Raises Broader Concerns
content:
A care facility in Kanchanaburi, Thailand made headlines in early October when photos of conditions in the facility went viral, including images allegedly depicting metal cages that confine residents to their beds. Further investigation by the country’s Department of Health Service Support uncovered unsanitary conditions and overcrowding, as well as evidence that the facility had been treating residents with psychosocial disabilities (mental health conditions) without an appropriate license.

The whistleblower, known as “Mae Phat,” appeared on television to recount her experiences at Sothornchai Nursing Home as a former resident, describing how she was involuntarily committed, forced to take medication, and physically restrained, often for hours at a time.

Thai officials promptly ordered the facility’s closure as well as inspections of 1,203 facilities for older people nationwide. While the authorities have taken appropriate first steps, conditions at the facility have raised broader concerns about institutionalization, shackling, and the treatment of older people in Thailand.

title: 30 Months After Uproar Over Jonathan Glazer’s Oscar Speech, What Do His Pro-Israel Denouncers Say Now?
content:
By Norman Solomon*

SAN FRANCISCO, 15 October 2026 (IDN) — If you understand that Israel has committed genocide in Gaza, why read an article focusing on the viewpoints of people who vehemently deny it? I wasn’t sure how to explain why, until I remembered something that screenwriter Frédéric Krivine said when I interviewed him in Paris eight years ago. He was the head scriptwriter of the brilliant film series Un Village Français, dramatizing the Nazi occupation of France during World War Two.

“People who do horrible things are human beings,” Krivine said. “We have to find a way to talk about them without hiding what they do and without treating them as nonhuman people, nonhuman beings. They are human beings; like us they belong to, we are in, the same species, human species…. It’s humans who kill now everywhere in the world where people are killed. It’s because they are human beings that we have problems – because if they were just extraterrestrial or monsters we could just erase them.”

title: Ten Findings Policymakers Should Read Before Proposing Research Rights Reform
content:
In June 2026, the European Commission published an independent report designed to strengthen the evidence base for future decisions about implementing Secondary Publication Rights (SPRs) as well as a harmonised copyright exception for research. 

This was intended to complement the existing legal and survey-based analysis developed in the major 2024 report on how copyright and other digital laws could better support research. By exploring the potential costs and benefits for all parties, it would help prepare the way for the formal impact assessment process required before any new legislation can be proposed in Europe. 

It comes in the context of growing concern (also highlighted in the report) about whether Europe and its institutions can afford a scholarly communications model focused strongly on proprietary publishing, or whether alternatives exist.

With legislation potentially addressing these questions at most a few months away (at least on available information at the time of writing), the study merits another look.

title: Kysyimme kohun keskelle joutuneen Itäkeskuksen peruskoulun oppilailta, mitä heistä tuli – ”Olen hirveän ylpeä siitä, missä olen käynyt kouluni”
content:
”On outo ajatus, että koulun monikielisyys olisi jotenkin haitannut omaa opiskeluani”

Olen Mellunkylästä ja aloitin koulutieni lähikoulussani Kontulan ala-asteella.

Menin Itäkeskuksen peruskouluun kolmannelle luokalle vuonna 2010, koska koulussa oli kielipainotus. Se tarkoittaa sitä, että on mahdollista opiskella ensimmäisenä vieraana kielenä jotain muuta kuin englantia. Valitsin ranskan. Äitini osaa myös ranskaa ja ajatteli, että voi tukea minua tarvittaessa.

Suurin osa koulukavereista oli Itä-Helsingistä. Olimme tosi heterogeeninen joukko, monikulttuurinen ja monikielinen. Luokallani oli kantasuomalaisten lisäksi monia, joiden vanhemmista joko molemmat tai jompikumpi oli kotoisin muualta kuin Suomesta. Luokallani oli esimerkiksi bangladeshilaistaustainen, marokkolaistaustainen, kosovolaistaustainen ja somalialaistaustainen oppilas.

Valtaosa luokallamme puhui erinomaista suomea. Luokallani oli paljon monikielisiä oppilaita, jotka opiskelivat suomea äidinkielenä, koska heillä oli vahva suomen kielen taito. S2-oppilaita oli myös jonkun verran.

title: What We Can Save In A Time Of Endings
content:
HAPPISBURGH, England — Off the coast of Norfolk on edge of the North Sea, the ocean can seem calm, but the waters are deceptive. Beneath the marbled brown, lie sand banks and submerged mountains waiting to ensnare unsuspecting ships. Happisburgh (pronounced Hays-burro) is a small, pretty town, its narrow roads lined by houses with walls made of flint pressed into mortar. The beach roads all have names like Stone’s Throw or Cliff Top, and the sea has always been present in people’s lives. But inching ever closer for years, now its incursions are rapid and frightening.

The light changed suddenly. Over my shoulder, the sky was dark with rain that towered in hazy columns against a thunderous glow. It rolled over the beach, over the houses, falling into the sea, billowing over the crumbling cliff edge. Lightning split the blackness, and the clouds rumbled. Gulls soared like scraps of loose paper, and sand martins wheeled in a frenzy, seeking refuge. For a moment, the world had ended. Then, it was clear again: sun shining, birds calling, people laughing.

title: Jaguar Trafficking in Latin America Persists Through Bone Paste and Pet Smuggling
content:
Skins in markets, fangs turned into jewelry, and bones processed into paste: the illegal trade in jaguars persists in Latin America. An investigation spanning seven countries points to a primarily local, small-scale business, with evidence of international trafficking in Peru and Suriname.

Between 2023 and 2025, the Wildlife Justice Commission (WJC) investigated the trade of these big cats in Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Chile, Panama, Peru, and Suriname. Its findings—shared with OCCRP—describe a market that often relies on sporadic sales opportunities, though the investigation also identified a network trafficking multiple species.

The latest WJC report "The Illegal Jaguar Trade in Latin America: An Updated Picture," published Thursday, found that a significant portion of the demand stems from local buyers, including members of Asian communities residing in the region. These results add nuance to alarms raised in the early 2010s regarding a new international market for jaguar parts targeting China, while not ruling out the continued existence of those connections.

title: The Megaprojects That Even the Ancient Romans Couldn’t Pull Off: Rerouting the Tiber, Digging a Canal, and More
content: Some would call the United States of America the mightiest empire the world has ever known. Yet over the past half-century or so, it has shown a strange inability to build domestic infrastructure, at least at the efficiency or on the scale seen elsewhere in the world. (This will not come as news to American enthusiasts of high-speed rail.) Here on Open Culture, we’ve previously featured history YouTuber Garrett Ryan’s take on the question of whether the U.S. is now declining like the ancient Roman Empire. On a more recent video for his channel Told in Stone, he’s highlighted the megaprojects that even the Romans — who managed the Pantheon, the Colosseum, and the Pont du Gard, to say nothing of their uniquely long-lasting concrete itself — couldn’t pull off.

title: Trump Says the Border Is Secure. Texas Gov. Greg Abbott Keeps Declaring an Emergency.
content:
Last month, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott repeated a claim he’s made for the past five years. He stated that the number of people crossing the Texas-Mexico border illegally “posed an ongoing and imminent threat” across the state. In doing so, he renewed a border security disaster proclamation that has greatly expanded his powers without going through the state Legislature.

Abbott’s declaration stands in sharp contrast to the numbers reported by the Trump administration, which says the drop in the flow of migrants crossing the border has been unprecedented and has reached historic lows since it took over in January 2025. 

Yet, since Abbott first declared an emergency at the border during the Biden administration in 2021, he’s renewed or amended the proclamation at least 69 times — 21 of those during Trump’s tenure.

title: Millions of phones exposed to Israeli spyware operation through online ads, researchers say
content:
An Israeli surveillance technology firm has run a large-scale operation to infect mobile phones with spyware using online advertisements to hack the devices, researchers said on Thursday.

An investigation by the University of Toronto’s Citizen Lab and cybersecurity firm Confiant Threat Intelligence laid bare an ad-based infection technique developed by an Israeli company that researchers named “AdFection.” The hacks weaponized legitimate online ad systems for espionage purposes, allowing spyware manufacturers to connect to millions of devices and identify, track and target victims.

“Plugging into the online ads ecosystem provides the mercenary spyware industry a stealthy delivery system,” said Bill Marczak, senior researcher at The Citizen Lab. He said the findings were “surely just the tip of the iceberg” of how online ads are abused for espionage.

Researchers discovered critical details of the hacking tools by analyzing devices belonging to journalists and staff at the Al Jazeera media network, finding that 45 devices of journalists and staff were targeted and some infected with Israeli-made spyware known as Candiru.

title: How an accelerating Earth led experts to adopt the leap hour
content:
International delegates agree leap second no longer tenable, but first leap hour not likely to happen for thousands of years

After decades of discussion, quibbling and worrying about clocks in computer systems, the world’s official timekeepers have voted to replace what many viewed as a tiresome correction: the leap second. It’s time, they say, for the leap hour.

Delegates from 69 countries cast their votes on Thursday at a conference in France of the International Bureau of Weights and Measures, which ensures the world sticks to the same standards of time, weight, distance and more.

title: Musiikin luovan alkutuotannon lausunto valtion talousarviosta 2027
content:
HE 175/2026 vp

Valtiovarainvaliokunnan sivistys- ja tiedejaostolle

Musiikin luova alkutuotanto on Teoston, Suomen Musiikintekijöiden, Suomen Säveltäjien ja Suomen Musiikkikustantajien muodostama kokoonpano. Edustamme yhdessä säveltäjiä, sanoittajia, sovittajia ja musiikkikustantajia musiikin lajista riippumatta. Kiitämme mahdollisuudesta lausua hallituksen esityksestä valtion talousarvioksi vuodelle 2027.

Taiteen ja kulttuurin harkinnanvaraisten avustusten leikkaus 7,7 prosentilla heikentää alan tilaa entisestään.
  • Kulttuurituotteiden ja -palvelujen arvonlisävero tulee palauttaa 10 prosenttiin. Veronkorotus on heikentänyt kysyntää, kulttuurin saavutettavuutta sekä alan yritysten ja tekijöiden toimintaedellytyksiä. Tämä on vastoin kulttuuripoliittisen selonteon tavoitetilaa.
  • Kulttuuripoliittisen selonteon ja luovan talouden kasvustrategian toimeenpanolle on varattava riittävät määrärahat ja edellytykset.

title: Virpi Kalakosken Aivotyötä!-teos kertoo, kuinka työtä ja arkea voi helpottaa ymmärtämällä ihmisen tiedonkäsittelyn kykyjä ja rajoja
content:
Oppiminen ja ajatustyö ovat taitolajeja. Psykologian tohtori ja Työterveyslaitoksen tutkimuspäällikkö Virpi Kalakosken teos Aivotyötä! Ihmisen tiedonkäsittelyn kyvyt ja rajat kertoo, miten mieltä kuormittavissa arjen tilanteissa on mahdollista toimia järkevämmin. Tekoälyn hyödyntäminen voi auttaa, mutta sillä on myös vaaransa.

Työelämä ja muu arki kuormittavat mieltämme jatkuvilla keskeytyksillä, tietotulvalla ja samanaikaisilla vaatimuksilla. Ihmisen tiedonkäsittelyn peruspiirteet ovat kuitenkin säilyneet samoina tuhansia vuosia. Jotta voisimme toimia järkevämmin ja luoda toimivia työympäristöjä ja käytäntöjä, pitää ymmärtää havaitsemisen, tarkkaavaisuuden, työmuistin sekä oppimisen kyvyt ja rajat.

Kognitiivisen psykologian tutkimustietoon nojaavassa Aivotyötä! -kirjassa Virpi Kalakoski purkaa sitkeitä myyttejä monitekemisestä ja muistin kehittämisestä mutta muistuttaa samalla, miten huikea on kykymme oppia uutta ja suoriutua vaativissa tehtävissä. Oppiminen ja ajatustyö ovat taitolajeja, joissa harjoitus tekee mestarin. Edellytyksenä kuitenkin on, ettei toimintaympäristömme luo tarpeetonta kuormaa vaan helpottaa aivotyössä onnistumista.

title: Food and fuel run low as besieged Yemeni city braces for Houthi breakthrough
content:
Speed of advance has left people rushing to buy food as basic supplies to city are cut off by fighting

Ali Abdulsamed spent all day waiting and walking. Like many people in the besieged Yemeni city of Taiz, he was searching for some food for his family of six. But each time he reached the end of the queue at the grocers, he was greeted with empty shelves. He would go on foot to the next shop, unable to afford the price of petrol, which more than doubled last week.

After visiting more than a dozen stores, Abdulsamed managed to find a 25kg bag of wheat flour – sold at more than twice its usual price. It would have to do, he was lucky to find anything at all.

title: A Day for Writing and Being Together: Writing Retreat at Värans Gård
content:
The main idea of the retreat was to give researchers uninterrupted time to focus on their ongoing writing and research while being together as a community. Throughout the day, everyone found their own place and rhythm for working. Some settled around the large working tables, others at smaller tables, on couches or in quieter corners of the house. Some also made use of the sauna and barn as quiet spaces when they needed to attend online classes or give lectures. 

Värans Gård offered a very different setting from an ordinary working day at the university. The nineteenth-century house, surrounded by fields and forest in the Finnish countryside, provided different spaces to work, pause and come together during the day.

title: Maailman joet kärsivät 2025 yhdestä kuivimmista vuosistaan
content:
Maailman jokien virtaamat olivat viime vuonna yksi kolmen vuosikymmenen kuivimmista. Näin kertoo Maailman ilmatieteen järjestön WMO:n selvitys globaalista vesikierrosta. Uutisesta kertoi Guardian.

WMO:n mukaan maan päällä ja maan alla olevan makean veden määrä oli viime vuonna 42 prosenttia normaalia pienempi. Luku kattaa pohjaveden, järvet, joet, lumen, jään sekä maaperän ja kasvien sisältämän kosteuden.

Vain noin kolmanneksella maailman joista virtaamat pysyivät normaalin rajoissa. Jokien valuma-alueiden pinta-alasta 36 prosentilla virtaamat olivat normaalia pienempiä tai selvästi sitä pienempiä, ja 21 prosentilla normaalia suurempia. Normaalitilassa olevien jokialueiden osuus oli seitsemättä vuotta peräkkäin selvässä vähemmistössä, noin 34–38 prosentissa, kun vuosien 1991–2020 keskiarvo on 46 prosenttia. Selvitys perustuu kolmeentoista globaaliin hydrologiseen malliin, joita ajettiin havaituilla säätiedoilla.

Myös jäätiköt kutistuvat. Maailman kaikki 19 suurta jäätikköaluetta menettivät jäämassaa neljättä vuotta peräkkäin. Viime vuonna jäätä suli 400 gigatonnia, mikä nosti merenpintaa 1,1 millimetriä.

WMO:n pääsihteeri Celeste Saulo vertaa tilannetta säästötiliin.

title: Wissen auf Abruf: Was wirklich hinter den KI-Antworten steckt
content:
Eine Frage eingeben, wenige Sekunden warten, eine fertige Antwort erhalten: Generative KI macht es so einfach wie nie, Informationen abzufragen. Doch leicht gerät aus dem Blick, was dahintersteckt: verlässliche Quellen, offene Wissenssammlungen und vor allem Menschen, die Wissen zusammentragen, überprüfen und zugänglich machen.

KI erzeugt Wissen nicht selbst. Die Systeme greifen auf Inhalte aus dem offenen Web zurück, darunter auch auf Wikipedia. Dort recherchieren, schreiben und diskutieren ehrenamtliche Wikipedia-Autor*innen, prüfen Quellen und korrigieren Fehler. Was sie gemeinsam schaffen, wird zunehmend von Maschinen verarbeitet und als neue Antwort ausgegeben.

Aber was passiert dabei mit dem Wissen, seiner Herkunft und den Menschen dahinter? Wie können wir nachvollziehen, auf welchen Quellen eine Antwort beruht? Welche Regeln gelten für die Nutzung der neu erstellten Inhalte? Diese Fragen haben der Wikipedia-Administrator Johannes Richter und Rechtsanwalt und Wikipedianer Lukas Mezger auf der Frankfurter Buchmesse beleuchtet.

title: Accenture Tells Employees They Can Now Spend Only $29 on Claude Per Month
content:
Consulting giant Accenture has told many employees that the company will now only spend $29 a month per person on Claude. Employees subject to the cap, some of whom had been spending as much as $1,000 monthly, are scrambling to find ways to make sure they can keep spending as much as they already are.

The news is a snapshot of what continues to play out across all sorts of industries: companies have spent heavily on AI tools, and are now discovering that many users are burning or “chewing” through AI tokens at a rapid clip. In response, many companies have curbed their employees’ AI use. There is a special irony to Accenture doing much of the same, when it is a company that has encouraged its clients to invest heavily into AI.

“Claude Enterprise Users: Important Updates to Licensing and Usage Costs,” a recent internal Accenture announcement, seen by 404 Media, reads.

It says that effective October 1, Accenture introduced new changes to how Claude Enterprise costs are funded and charged. That includes centrally funding only $29 a month per person towards Claude usage.

title: COP17: Developed countries ‘fall far short’ of UN targets for nature finance
content:
The amount of finance for nature delivered to date “falls far short” of what is needed to meet the UN’s global goals, according to a report released ahead of the COP17 biodiversity summit. 

The global stocktaking report, prepared by the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (UN CBD) ahead of this month’s summit in Armenia, finds that developed nations are failing to close the $200bn “biodiversity finance gap”. 

Initiatives designed to support this goal are also stumbling, with a special “framework” fund for biodiversity receiving less than $140m from developed countries in the past two years and the “landmark” Cali Fund receiving only $6,000 from private companies.

The availability of finance – or lack thereof – is likely to be a key point of contention in negotiations at COP17 in Yerevan, Armenia, which begin on 19 October. 

At COP15 in 2022, 196 countries agreed to an ambitious global deal to reverse biodiversity loss by 2030, dubbed the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF).

Goal D of the agreement, shown below, states that countries must “close” a $700bn “biodiversity finance gap” by 2030.

title: The Midterm Battle over Data Centers: Memphis House Candidate Justin Pearson Fights Elon Musk's xAI
content:
The energy needs of the AI boom and the construction of massive data centers in states across the country have created a backlash from both Democratic and Republican voters. The battle against data centers is at the heart of a campaign in Tennessee: Democratic state Representative Justin J. Pearson is opposed to the Colossus data centers built by Elon Musk’s xAI in the Memphis area. Pearson is running against Republican state Senator Brent Taylor in Tennessee’s 9th Congressional District, which, after recent redistricting, includes parts of Memphis, as well as rural and suburban counties.

“Across the 15 counties that I’ve traveled, I’ve yet to meet anyone, including folks who are Republicans who are voting for us, who want data centers,” says Pearson. “Gas is high; groceries are high; healthcare costs are high; wages are low. Yet the billionaire class continues to profit off of our pain and pillage our communities and our pocketbooks.”

title: Kansanedustajat haastoivat ministeriä hoitotakuusta ja asiakasmaksuista – Rydman: Oppositiopropagandaa
content:
Eduskunnan kyselytunnilla oppositio tenttasi hallitusta hoitoon pääsystä ja terveydenhuollon asiakasmaksuista.

Kyselytunnin aiheet ovat olleet viime aikoina esillä mediassa. Syöpähoitoihin pääsyn viivästymisestä on kertonut Ylen MOT. Helsingin Sanomat taas uutisoi torstaina, että köyhät perheet jättävät jopa lasten sairaalahoitoa väliin, koska asiakasmaksut ovat heille liikaa.

Kyselytunnin avannut kansanedustaja Hanna Laine-Nousimaa (sd.) kertoi omasta kokemuksestaan, kun hänen isänsä oli saanut keukosyöpädiagnoosin vasta noin kymmenen kuukautta ensimmäisten oireiden jälkeen. Se herättää hänessä kysymyksen, olisiko asiat voitu selvittää aikaisemmin.

– Tiedän, miltä tuntuu olla syöpäsairaan läheinen ja odottaa tietoa. Siksi en voi ymmärtää, miksi hallitus pidensi hoitotakuun kahdesta viikosta kolmeen kuukauteen. Joillekin tuo aika voi määrittää koko loppuelämän keston, hän sanoi.

– Jos potilaan tila pääsee perusterveydenhuollon viiveen vuoksi pahenemaan, hän tarvitsee myöhemmin raskaampia ja kalliimpia hoitojaksoja. Joidenkin kohdalla se tarkoittaa ohjaamista parantavasta hoidosta palliatiiviseen hoitoon.

title: From Milan to Toolforge: How a Wikimedia Hackathon Sparked WikiLinkua
content:
In May 2026, I travelled to Milan, Italy, for the Wikimedia Hackathon 2026. It was my first international trip, and an opportunity I had never imagined for myself. I arrived with a project idea, a few days to work on it, and no idea that I would leave with the beginnings of something I would continue building months later.

Looking back, Milan was not just about attending an international event. It was about discovering how a community of people with different backgrounds, skills, and interests can turn an idea into something others can use.

I arrived in Milan planning to work on a Wikidata watchlist filtering script. The idea was to make reviewing edits more manageable by allowing users to filter their watchlist by categories. I completed the script on the first day.

With time left, I joined an unconference session by Satdeep Gill and Silvia Gutiérrez. Their discussion introduced me to WikiLinkua, a language-learning platform built around Wikidata Lexemes and Wiktionary.

The idea caught my attention: what if people could learn a new language using languages they already know, while also helping improve the free knowledge that makes this possible?

title: Poland Lost PLN 490 Billion Helping Ukraine?
content:
Statistics Poland (GUS) estimated the loss in Poland’s gross domestic product (GDP) between 2022 and 2025 at PLN 490.1 billion (EUR 112,17 bln). The release of these figures quickly became fodder for disinformation. Claims began circulating on social media alleging that this sum represents the direct cost of military and humanitarian aid provided to Kyiv by the Polish government. 

As independent fact-checking organizations such as Demagog determined, this is manipulation based on a selective reading of macroeconomic indicators, intended to stir public sentiment against continuing aid to Ukraine. In reality, GUS’s calculations do not refer to direct financial transfers from the state budget, but to the costs of the economic shock caused by Russia’s invasion of Poland’s eastern neighbor.

title: Miten väestösokit näkyvät Suomi24-keskustelupalstalla?
content:
Hedelmällisyyden lasku 2010–2024, koronaepidemia 2020–2022 ja nettomuuton jyrkkä kasvu 2022–2024 ovat tuoreita esimerkkejä väestösokeista. Miten sokit on kansan keskuudessa ymmärretty?

Suomi24-keskustelupalsta on toiminut vuoden 2001 alusta. Tarkastelun kohteeksi luotiin neljä aiheryhmää. Viestejä oli runsaat 1,26 miljoonaa, ja ne muodostavat tutkimuksen korpuksen. Aiheryhmissä laskettiin substantiivien ja adjektiivien frekvenssit ja valittiin vajaan 8 000 yleisimmän yhdelmä sanastoksi. Kussakin aihepiirissä havaittujen purskeperiodien kieltä ja sen muutosta tutkittiin kuvaamalla sanat neliulotteiseen avaruuteen. Analyysiä täydennettiin lukemalla otospohjalla yhteensä runsaat 2 000 viestiä. Oman luentamme ohella käytimme Gemini-tekoälyä tuottamaan yhteenvetoja otosviestien sisällöstä.

title: Globaali hintavertailu: Suomessa ruokakorin saa alle kahden tunnin työllä, köyhimmissä maissa siihen kuluu jopa kuukausi
content:
Suomessa on tehtävä töitä vain 1,7 tuntia, jotta saa ostettua 10 tarvikkeen ruokakorin. Maailman köyhimmissä maissa sama ruokakori vaatii päiviä tai jopa viikkoja työtä. Keski-Afrikan tasavallassa sen ostamiseen kuluu lähes 30 päivää.

Avustusjärjestö World Visionin vuosittainen Price Shocks -raportti vertailee tavallisen ruokakorin ostamiseen vaadittavaa työaikaa 62 eri maassa. Korissa on mukana muun muassa kilo riisiä, jauhoja, banaaneja, tomaatteja sekä ruokaöljyä.

Korkean tulotason maissa, kuten Iso-Britanniassa tai Yhdysvalloissa, ostokset saa tienattua 1,2 tunnissa. Sudanissa kuluu yli 19 työpäivää ja Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa reilut kaksi viikkoa.

Riittävä terveellinen ruokavalio on maailmanlaajuisesti yhä joka kolmannen ihmisen ulottumattomissa.

- Kun ruoan hinta nousee, kaikkein köyhimmillä perheillä ei yksinkertaisesti ole enää varaa ravitsevaan ruokaan. He joutuvat ostamaan vähemmän, valitsemaan halvempia vaihtoehtoja tai jättämään aterioita väliin, sanoo Suomen World Visionin toiminnanjohtaja Annette Gothóni.

Vuonna 2025 maailmassa arvioitiin olevan 35,5 miljoonaa akuutisti aliravittua lasta. Heistä lähes 10 miljoonaa kärsi vakavasta akuutista aliravitsemuksesta.

title: Freedom House Adopts Cases of Imprisoned Vietnamese Journalists Le Anh Hung and Pham Chi Dung
content:
Washington, DC—Freedom House announced today that the Fred Hiatt Program to Free Political Prisoners has adopted the cases of imprisoned Vietnamese journalists Le Anh Hung and Pham Chi Dung, both of whom were formerly affiliated with the international multimedia broadcaster Voice of America.

“Freedom House is proud to stand with Le Anh Hung and Pham Chi Dung and fight for their release,” said Jamie Fly, CEO of Freedom House. “Vietnam has one of the most restrictive media environments in the world, with independent journalists routinely detained, prosecuted, and imprisoned. We call for Le Anh Hung and Pham Chi Dung to be immediately and unconditionally released.”

Le Anh Hung is an independent journalist who published articles on a range of topics, including politics and corruption, for a variety of independent media outlets, including Voice of America. He was arrested by Vietnamese authorities on March 9, 2026, and has been detained since. He is charged with "propaganda against the state," which carries a sentence of up to 20 years in prison. He was previously imprisoned from 2018 to 2023 for “abusing democratic freedoms to infringe upon the interests of the state.”

title: Cambodian Supreme Court Maximizes Sentence for Opposition Activist
content:
Cambodia’s Supreme Court on October 14 denied opposition activist Voeung Samnang’s request to serve his two sentences concurrently, meaning he will spend 11 years in prison. Samnang had been convicted on charges of “plotting an attack on the state” and received sentences of five and six years.

The case illustrates the Cambodian government’s increased use of vague plotting charges to prosecute opposition activists and social media users and sentence them to long prison terms.

Samnang had been a local commune official for the Cambodia National Rescue Party (CNRP), the opposition party dissolved by the government-controlled Supreme Court in 2017. He fled to Thailand in 2020 after charges were filed against him. In 2021, Thai police arrested him and forcibly returned him to Cambodia, alongside opposition activist Veourn Veasna, despite both being recognized as refugees by the United Nations refugee agency.

title: Interpol Operation Nets 95 Arrests for Child Abuse
content:
An international operation coordinated by Interpol has resulted in the arrest of 95 individuals suspected of producing and distributing child sexual exploitation and abuse material. According to a Thursday statement, the six-month operation, conducted between March and September 2026, spanned 17 countries across Latin America and Europe.

Authorities targeted platforms and cryptocurrencies used to groom children, coordinate abuse, connect offenders, and receive payments for illegal content. Of the arrested suspects, 89 percent were male and 11 percent were female. Among those detained are the parents of a five-year-old victim, accused of producing and selling abuse material of the child online.

title: Watch “The Midnight Parasites,” a Surreal Japanese Animation Set in the World of Hieronymus Bosch’s The Garden of Earthly Delights (1972)
content:
Hieronymus Bosch’s bizarre paintings might have looked perfectly ordinary to his contemporaries, argues Stanley Meisler in “The World of Bosch.” Modern viewers may find this very hard to believe. We approach Bosch through layers of Freudian interpretation and Surrealist appreciation. We cannot help “regarding the scores of bizarre monsters”—allegories for sins and punishments far more legible in 15th-century Netherlands—“as a kind of dark and cruel comic relief.”

While Bosch might have intended his work as serious sermonizing, it is impossible for us to inhabit the medieval consciousness of his time and place. There’s just no getting around the fact that Bosch is really weird—weirder even (or more imaginatively allegorical) than nearly any other artist of his time. In some very important ways, he belongs to a 20th-century aesthetic of post-Freudian dream logic as much as he belonged to peculiar medieval visions of heaven and hell.

title: Frustrated by Losses in the Courts, Missouri Republicans Want to Change How Top Judges Are Selected
content:
Some 86 years ago, Missouri voters enshrined a system for selecting top judges that would remove political influence from the courts. And almost immediately, it came under attack.

Under what has come to be known as the Missouri Plan, lawyers help choose a slate of three candidates from which the governor must make an appointment for the state Supreme Court, appeals courts and, in some populous areas, the circuit courts. 

In the first years after adoption, it faced pushback from party bosses who had historically used judicial seats for political patronage. They said it gave too much power to the lawyers. Voters, though, decisively defeated a repeal measure in 1942. 

More recently, the conservative activist Leonard Leo, who viewed Missouri as a crucial battleground, tried in 2007 to persuade Republican Gov. Matt Blunt to reject a slate of Supreme Court candidates — part of a broader effort to weaken a judicial selection system that had become a model for some two dozen states around the country. 

Blunt resisted and picked one of the three judges from the approved slate.

title: Why Ukrainian strikes on data centers are a real problem for Russia — and beyond
content:
Ukraine’s strikes on data centers inside Russia aimed to disrupt military planning and communication services. There were also reports of another kind of disruption: to customers waiting for their dinner from food-delivery apps.

Kyiv’s drone strikes on three Yandex data centers in Sasovo, Kaluga and Vladimir saw delays and interruptions for thousands of businesses and households that rely on Yandex’s cloud infrastructure, including e-commerce, digital payment platforms and apps of food delivery and car services. Ukrainian drones on Wednesday targeted a major Sberbank data center in Russia’s Saratov region, though a senior company executive said it hadn’t affected operations.

After the strikes on Russian data centers, Kyiv noted that Moscow has already repeatedly targeted its digital infrastructure. “Ukrainians wanted to show Russians that two can play this game,” a senior official familiar with the operation told POLITICO, granted anonymity to discuss sensitive matters.

The attacks and counter-attacks point to a new frontline in war: the infrastructure powering the digital economy.

title: European flounder can complete whole life cycle in freshwater
content:
European flounders (Platichthys flesus) are marine fish that often move into river mouths to feed. They are considered to return to marine or brackish water to reproduce. An international research team has shown that the flounders of Lake Pulmanki are an exception: they can complete their entire life cycle in freshwater.

Lake Pulmanki is a former Arctic Ocean fjord that became a freshwater lake after the last ice age and is currently connected to sea via 60 km long river section.

When flounders were first documented in Lake Pulmanki in the 1970s, researchers could not explain their presence. The fish could have been migrating to the lake to feed and returning to the Barents Sea to spawn. Alternatively, flounders could have adapted to a full freshwater life cycle. 

The team approached the question in two ways. Using otolith microchemistry, the researchers analysed otoliths, small bony structures in a fish’s inner ear that help it sense balance and movement. As otoliths grow, their chemical composition preserve a record of the waters a fish has occupied.

title: Hyrkkö moittii Orpon mediapolitiikkaa: STT:n pelastaminen jätetty markkinoiden varaan
content:
STT on yksi maailman vanhimmista tietotoimistoista. Vihreiden kansanedustaja Saara Hyrkkö pitää sen lopettamisuhkaa erittäin huolestuttavana.  

”Pääministerin mukaan STT:tä koskevan ratkaisun pitää löytyä markkinoilta sen sijaan, että valtio tulisi osalliseksi. Jostain syystä hallitus kuitenkin tuli hätiin, kun kyse oli Valmet Automotiven pelastamisesta. Pääministerin periaatteellisuus vaikuttaa olevan valikoivaa”, ihmettelee Hyrkkö vihreiden tiedotteessa.

”Suomalaisen uutistoiminnan ja monimuotoisen mediakentän turvaaminen ovat mitä suurimmassa määrin turvallisuuteen, kriisinkestävyyteen ja demokratiaan liittyviä kysymyksiä, joissa valtiolla tulisi olla poikkeuksellisen suuri intressi”, jatkaa Hyrkkö.

Kotimaisen uutistoimiston merkitys korostuu Hyrkön mukaan Suomen kaltaisella pienellä kielialueella.

”Ilman STT:n uutistoimintaa moni suomalaisille tärkeä asia jäisi eri puolilla Suomea pureskelematta. Rapakon takaiset tapahtumat korostuvat jo nyt uutisvirrassa, ja teknologia-alustojen kautta kansalaisten saamaa tietoa ohjaavat entistä vahvemmin Euroopan ulkopuolella rakennetut algoritmit. Tämän kaiken vastapainoksi tarvitaan kotimaista uutistoimintaa”, sanoo Hyrkkö.

title: Video Game Reverse Engineering Community Shuts Down Because AI Has Made It Too Easy
content:
A website that was dedicated to the human endeavor of reverse engineering, “decompiling,” and modifying video games is shutting down because people using AI to clone and decompile games have fully overrun the community and are far outpacing what human software engineers alone can do. The news comes as AI-coded “clones” of popular enterprise software like the Adobe creative suite and Microsoft Office have gone viral and are seemingly popping up every day, and as people in video game modding communities warn that 'AI decomps' are everywhere. 

The website decomp.dev said Thursday that it is shutting down because “the community aspect of decompilation has been broken” by AI, and that projects that once required intense collaboration between people with different skills can now be done trivially with AI. The administrator of the website said that it has become impossible to keep track of which projects are primarily human-led and which ones are done by AI.

title: U.S. Sanctions ICC in a Bid to Avoid "Criminal Liability": War Crimes Prosecutor Reed Brody
content:
The Trump administration on Friday placed sweeping sanctions on the International Criminal Court that target the institution as a whole. This comes on top of earlier sanctions against individual ICC judges and personnel. The administration has been escalating attacks on the ICC since the court issued arrest warrants in 2024 for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant. It announced the sanctions just hours after former ICC Judge Navi Pillay — the South African jurist who led the United Nations commission of inquiry that concluded that Israel had committed genocide in Gaza — was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize.

“This is really an insurance policy against accountability for crimes that the United States and its ally Israel are committing in plain sight,” says war crimes prosecutor Reed Brody, a member of the International Commission of Jurists. The sanctions, which prevent U.S.-based banks and companies from transacting with the ICC, constitute an “existential attack” on the court, he says.

title: Suomen hyvinvointia ei rakenneta leikkaamalla
content:
Suomen historia osoittaa, että yhteiskuntaa rakennetaan parhaiten luomalla uskoa parempaan tulevaisuuteen ja antamalla ihmisille mahdollisuuksia yrittää, tehdä työtä, kartuttaa osaamistaan ja rakentaa parempaa huomista itselleen ja tuleville sukupolville. Hyvinvointivaltiota ei rakennettu leikkaamalla ihmisten mahdollisuuksia, vaan laajentamalla niitä.

Tätä historiallista opetusta ei pidä unohtaa nykyisessä talouspolitiikassa.

Itsenäistymisen aikaan maaomaisuus oli suomalaisten tärkeintä varallisuutta. Torpparivapautus ja maareformit antoivat yhä useammalle mahdollisuuden hankkia omaa maata. Työn tuloksista pääsi itse hyötymään, ja omaisuus toi turvaa sekä kannusti yrittämiseen.

Sotien jälkeen evakkojen ja rintamamiesten asuttaminen, maanhankinta, valtionmetsien jakaminen pientilojen lisämetsiksi ja asuntorakentamisen valtionlainat tarjosivat monelle uuden alun. Lisäksi asuntolainojen verovähennysoikeus helpotti oman kodin hankkimista.

Nämä olivat paljon enemmän kuin maa- ja asuntopoliittisia uudistuksia. Ne olivat investointi ihmisiin. Kun työn tuloksista saattoi itse nauttia ja omaisuutta kartuttaa, syntyi kannustimia työntekoon, yrittämiseen ja tulevaisuuden rakentamiseen.

title: From What We Explored at the September 2026 EduWiki Knowledge Showcase
content:
What can Wikimedia education look like in different learning environments?

The September 2026 EduWiki Knowledge Showcase brought together experiences from Wikimedia communities in Central and Eastern Europe and Central Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa, giving participants an opportunity to hear how different education programmes are being developed and implemented in their communities. The session also included an update from the EduWiki Hub and a capstone project from the first cohort of the EduWiki Mentorship Program.

Mari Avetisyan of Wikimedia Armenia presented the organisation’s university internship programme, which gives students an opportunity to apply their academic knowledge and language skills through contributions to Wikimedia projects.

The internship runs for around two months. Students begin with Wikipedia training before creating articles, including translations from English, Russian, Chinese and Korean. Wikimedia Armenia currently works with three universities, and over eight years, 609 students have participated in the programme by contributing to Wikipedia.

title: Tuusulan kulttuurikasvatussuunnitelma juhlii 10 vuotta
content:
Tuusulan perusopetuksen kulttuurikasvatussuunnitelma Kultsu täyttää tänä vuonna 10 vuotta. Kultsu on osa opetussuunnitelmaa, ja sen ansiosta jokainen tuusulalainen peruskoululainen pääsee vuosittain kokemaan ikätasoista taidetta, kulttuuria ja kulttuuriperintöä osana koulupäivää. Juhlia vietetään marraskuussa.

Kultsun 10 vuotta juhlia vietetään lauantaina 7.11. kulttuuritalo Moniolla syksyn Skidiviikon yhteydessä. Ohjelmassa on Teatteri Taimisen BullyBylly esitys, useita työpajoja sekä lastenmusiikkiyhtye Päistikkan esitys. Lauantain ohjelma on kaikille avointa.

Tuusulassa kulttuuri nähdään tärkeänä osana lasten ja nuorten kasvua, oppimista ja hyvinvointia. Kulttuurielämykset vahvistavat osallisuutta, identiteettiä ja luovuutta sekä tarjoavat uusia näkökulmia ympäröivän maailman ymmärtämiseen.

Kultsun tavoitteena on tarjota kaikille lapsille ja nuorille yhdenvertaiset mahdollisuudet tutustua kulttuuriin, osallistua siihen ja löytää oma suhteensa taiteeseen sekä paikalliseen kulttuuriperintöön. Vuosien varrella toiminta on laajentunut kattamaan myös varhaiskasvatuksen Taika-Kultsun ja toisen asteen Kultsun.

title: Chaos in Tirana: Violent Student Protests Surge
content:
Prime Minister Edi Rama addressed youth protesting in Tirana on Thursday for the first time after three days of violent demonstrations, calling them the country’s future and urging dialogue, while insisting that genuine students were not responsible for the widespread destruction.

Speaking in a video message recorded inside the damaged offices of the European Union-backed College of Europe in Tirana, Rama drew a sharp line between student concerns and the street violence that has paralyzed parts of the capital.

"Students are the future... and for them, we are always ready to sit down, speak, discuss, and find solutions," Rama said. However, he accused political opponents of hijacking the demonstrations, calling the attacks on public institutions the work of "an opposition which, hiding behind blind masks, seeks with fire and iron to drag Albania back into the abyss". Warning that the law applies to everyone, Rama vowed that anyone responsible for the devastation "will pay".

title: Eläkeläinen maksaa mieluiten kuoltuaan – kuolinpesä oikeudenmukainen tapa rahoittaa eläkeläisten osuus talkoista
content:
Eero Karisto 

Eläkeläisiä on kovasti kaivattu osallistumaan julkisen talouden tasapainottamiseen. Äärimmillään väitetään, että eläkeläiset eivät osallistu mitenkään valtiontalouden säästötoimiin. Tällöin unohdetaan, että kaikki vanhushoivaan tehdyt ja tehtävät leikkaukset sekä siihen kohdistuvat asiakasmaksujen korotukset osuvat juuri eläkeläisiin.

Samoin julkisen terveydenhuollon supistukset, nousevat asiakasmaksut ja toimipisteiden vähentyessä pidentyvät asiointimatkat koskevat ennen kaikkea eläkeläisiä. Työterveyshuollon parissa olevat eivät ole kohdanneet vastaavia leikkauksia.

Lisäksi esimerkiksi kulttuuripalvelujen leikkaukset koskevat nekin eläkeläisiä siinä missä muitakin.

Keskeinen väestönosa, joka ei ainakaan merkittävästi ole osallistunut talouden tasapainottamiseen, ovat keski-ikäiset keski- ja hyvätuloiset säännöllisessä palkkatyössä olevat eli ihmiset, joiden elämä muutenkin on keskimääräistä huomattavasti turvatumpaa.

title: ChatGPT Ads Target Your Phone Number, Email
content: There is a lot of stuff about how creepy ad targeting is in today’s newsletter. Our first story is one I did, about how advertisers — or really anyone with 5 minutes on their hands — can inject ads into your ChatGPT session based on your phone number or email address. This is pretty normal in the advertising world, but I seriously doubt that when most of ChatGPT’s many, many users see an ad, they realize that might be because someone, somewhere, uploaded their phone number into OpenAI’s systems. I made my own ad on ChatGPT (without using peoples’ personal data) to test out the system. Then, in other news, there is new research confirming, I think for the first time, that online ads are being used to deliver zero-click mercenary malware against targets.

title: Vihreiden näkemys bensaratkaisusta: Kaksinkertainen oma maali
content:
Kansanedustaja Saara Hyrkkö (vihr.) tiedottaa pettyneensä Petteri Orpon (kok.) hallituksen bensapakettiin.

Hyrkkö kritisoi paketin kohdennuksia. 60 miljoonan euron kokonaisuudesta puolet käytetään polttoainetukeen kuljetus- ja maatalousalalle, 20 miljoonaa ajoneuvoveron pysyvään keventämiseen ja 10 miljoonaa euroa työmatkakuluvähennyksen ylärajan korotukseen.

Hyrkkö muistuttaa, että hallitus on jo aiemmin keventänyt esimerkiksi ajoneuvoveroa erityisesti paljon saastuttavien polttomoottoriautojen osalta.

– Tämänkin elinkustannuskriisin juurisyy on liiallinen riippuvuus fossiilisista tuontipolttoaineista. Nyt hallitus syventää sitä entisestään, Hyrkkö sanoo tiedotteessaan.

Hän pitää tyrmistyttävänä, että rahoitus pakettiin löydettiin yhdestä hallituksen ainoasta ilmastotoimesta, eli piippujen tulppauksesta.

– On surkuhupaisaa, että hallituksen ilmastopolitiikan kärkitavoitteeseen varatut rahat käytetäänkin fossiiliautoilun tukemiseen. Näin irtoaa viimeinenkin tulppa hallituksen ilmastopolitiikan pohjasta. Hallitus tekee tässä kaksinkertaisen oman maalin: lisää päästöjä ja samalla vaikeuttaa tulevia päästövähennyksiä.

title: My experience at the Language Diversity Conference, Accra, Ghana
content:
Last week in Accra, I had the opportunity of being part of the maiden edition of the Language Diversity Conference held in Ghana, with the theme “Strengthening Language Communities in the Open Knowledge Movement”. I was one of the self-funded scholars, which Dagbani Wikimedians User Group funded to boost much participation in this conference.  The conference brought together over 82 language speakers and over 120 participants for a period of three days. It was hosted by the Dagbani Wikimedia User Group, Wikimedia UK, the Wikimedia Language Diversity Hub and Wikitongues.

This conference matters to all of us because digitalizing our languages goes a long way toward preserving them, and with them our pride. We have a lot of Dagaare speakers, and it would be unfortunate if we were unable to document our language. As Professor Samuel Alhassan Issah, Dean of the Faculty of Ghanaian Languages Education at the University of Education, Winneba, put it, “A language becomes minoritized because society makes it so, and even a language spoken by millions can be pushed to the margins.”

title: Mousa-Alreza Zoghi Moghaddam Arrested in Mashhad
content:
Based on information received by HRANA, Zoghi Moghaddam was arrested by security forces at his residence on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. The arrest was reportedly carried out with violence.

An informed source close to his family confirmed the news to HRANA, stating that Zoghi Moghaddam was transferred to Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad following his arrest. He is facing a charge of “assembly and collusion against national security.” The source added that after his family made inquiries regarding his temporary release, they were informed that bail had been set at 400 million tomans.

At the time of this report, no information was available regarding the specific acts underlying the charge against him.

title: Ny översättning av Nya testamentet, upplevelser av kriget och dagens åldringsvård i kyrkans samtal på bokmässan
content:
Evangelisk-lutherska kyrkan i Finland deltar i Helsingfors bokmässa 22–25 oktober med såväl samtal om aktuella ämnen som i en monter (6 V 10) delad med Fontana Media och Kyrkans Utlandshjälp.

Den nya översättningen av Nya testamentet NT 2026 kommer att synas i de samtal som kyrkan ordnar på fredag och lördag. Redaktör Monica Slotte diskuterar på fredag eftermiddag med Mikael Winninge från Svenska bibelsällskapet och religionsläraren, pastorn Jani Edström om vad som händer när bibeltexter översätts på nytt och formuleringar som läsarna vant sig vid plötsligt är annorlunda. Handlar det enbart om ovana vid det nya eller blir upplevelsen så stark att det känns som om vissa texter förstörs? Hur landar översättningen hos finlandssvenska läsare i olika åldrar?

Författarna Ellen Strömberg, Ralf Andtbacka och Hanna Ylöstalo samtalar på lördag eftermiddag med Eddie Myrskog om Bibeln som inspiration för författarskapet. Vilka är det i de stora texterna som berör och inspirerar?

title: UK Freezes £30 Million Mansion Linked to Alleged Senior Prince Group Associate
content:
The United Kingdom this month issued an asset freeze order on a £30 million ($39 million) mansion near Holland Park, central London, belonging to alleged senior Prince Group associate Hu Xiaowei, records reveal.

According to filings submitted to the U.K.’s Land Registry on October 5, the property was officially frozen in connection with the country’s March 2026 designation of Hu Xiaowei as a sanctioned individual and asset freeze target.

Hu Xiaowei did not respond to OCCRP’s request to comment for this article. 

OCCRP has reported extensively on Hu Xiaowei, including unmasking his multiple identities and his portfolio of global assets, including the Holland Park mansion.

Following allegations he held a senior role in Prince Group,  he has also been sanctioned by the United States, and been subject to asset freezes in Hong Kong, as well as a money laundering investigation in Singapore. Additionally, he has been indicted in Taiwan.

Now largely shuttered as a result of sweeping sanctions, Prince Group was a multi-billion dollar Cambodian conglomerate that allegedly secretly operated as one of Asia’s largest organized crime groups.

title: From Mario to machine guns: how Ubisoft Paris made Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics
content:
The studio is swapping the Mushroom Kingdom’s vivid palette for the blood-soaked grit of military action series

Where do you go after Mario? It’s a question the team at Ubisoft Paris found itself pondering three years ago after wrapping up work on the charming turn-based tactics adventure, Mario + Rabbids: Sparks of Hope, sequel to its unexpected crossover hit, Mario + Rabbids: Kingdom Battle. By melding a rather specialist genre with video gaming’s biggest household name, the developer introduced chin-stroking strategic play to a whole new audience. “Having the opportunity to work with the Mario franchise was a privilege, and it’s still something I’m very proud of,” says level designer director, Julien Vial. “I still remember seeing the first prototype and being blown away by all the possibilities.”

title: How ChatGPT Targets Ads To You Based On Your Prompts, Phone Number, and Email
content:
OpenAI lets anyone inject ads into ChatGPT users’ sessions, targeting specific groups of people based on their email address, phone number, or a unique identifier on their phone, according to 404 Media’s own tests of ChatGPT’s advertising ecosystem.

While the ad targeting available in ChatGPT is somewhat standard practice across the advertising industry, the chatbot’s one billion monthly active users may not understand they, in some cases, are being specifically targeted because of their personal data the advertiser has uploaded to OpenAI. ChatGPT’s ad targeting is also novel in that it is also based on the prompts users enter into the chatbot, prompts that users may assume are private but which, as 404 Media has previously shown, may be reviewed by humans. Or in this case, used for ad targeting purposes.

“OpenAI’s advertising products are operating just like most other massive companies which start to monetize their audiences — they are boiling the frog and hoping their users won’t notice the privacy implications from their new ads,” Zach Edwards, co-founder of DecryptAds, a company that collects online advertising data for research purposes, told 404 Media.

title: ”Bensafloppi!” – oppositiosta tyrmäys hallituksen bensasovulle
content:
– Hallituksen bensasovusta tuli floppi. Paljon puheita, mutta vähän villoja. Suurin osa työmatka-autoilijoista ei tästä hallituksen sovusta juuri hyödy, kansanedustaja ja valtiovarainvaliokunnan vastaava Joona Räsänen (sd) tiivistää.

Räsäsen mielestä kaiken riitelyn jälkeen hallitus sai aikaan vain paketin, jossa iso osa rahasta ”hassataan” ajoneuvoveron alennukseen – siitä riippumatta, kuinka useasti auto pihasta liikkuu.

– Ajoneuvoveron alennuksen hallitus rahoittaa perusväylänpidosta säästämällä. Eli lopputuloksena ajoneuvon omistaminen on jatkossa halvempaa, mutta tiet ovat huonommassa kunnossa.

SDP on aiemmin esittänyt muutosta verotuksen matkakuluvähennykseen niin, että korvauksen ylärajaa ja kilometrikohtaista korvausta korotetaan ja omavastuuta lasketaan.

– Matkakuluvähennyksen parantaminen on mahdollista säätää voimaan jo tälle vuodelle ja hyöty olisi suomalaisilla käytössä verokortin päivittämisellä. Näin varmistetaan, että töihin on aina kannattava lähteä ja työtä on aina kannattavaa ottaa vastaan pidemmänkin välimatkan päästä.

Bensasovun tulos saa Räsäsen uumoilemaan, että hallitusta kiinnosti ”enemmän julkinen miekkailu kuin ihmisten arjen kustannusten helpottaminen”.

title: Republicans and Democrats Agree on AI Reform
content:
Artificial intelligence has moved center stage in the upcoming midterm elections, propelled by a backlash against data centers and fears about AI safety. In response, Congress vows to act.

Democratic and Republican Members of Congress opened CEPA’s annual Tech & Security Conference with a rare sign of consensus: AI safety and innovation are not contradictory, insisted Representative Nathaniel Moran (R-TX-01). He compared the need for regulation to the rules that forced automobile companies to make cars safe.

“The brakes allow you to drive faster, not slower,” said Moran. “AI brakes should not slow innovation. They should enable faster movement with a safe backstop.”

This is the logic behind Moran’s proposed AI Kill Switch Act. Co-sponsored with Democratic Rep. Ted Lieu, it would require developers of the most powerful frontier AI models to be able to throttle, suspend, or completely shut models down if they threaten $100 million in economic damages or 10 deaths.

title: Open Letter: Drop charges against Rohingya human rights defender in Malaysia
content:
Dear Minister,

CIVICUS: World Alliance for Citizen Participation is a global alliance of civil society organisations (CSOs) and activists dedicated to strengthening citizen action and civil society worldwide. Founded in 1993, CIVICUS has over More than 17,000 members from over 175 countries.

We are writing to you regarding the charges brought against Rohingya human rights defender Zafar Ahmad Abdul Ghani, who heads the Myanmar Ethnic Rohingya Human Rights Organisation Malaysia (MERHROM). title: "Propaganda Show": IDF Raids Palestinian NGOs in the West Bank Ahead of Israeli Elections
content:
Israeli forces have raided what they say are the offices of several Palestinian NGOs in the occupied West Bank. Palestinian officials say a child was injured from Israeli gunfire, while others suffered from tear gas inhalation. At least one journalist was reportedly detained in the raids, which come four years after the forced closure of multiple NGOs that the Israeli government designated as “terrorist” organizations.

“This is part of the whole propaganda show that this government is actually implementing just before the Israeli election,” says human rights lawyer Sahar Francis. “They just wanted to cause harassment, and this is the main message: the persecution and the collective punishment for the whole Palestinian community.” Francis was formerly the general director at Addameer Prisoner Support and Human Rights Association, one of the organizations that Israel claims to have raided this week despite the fact that it was already forced to close its West Bank offices in 2022.

title: Näin Google selittää hakkuitaan viranomaisille: ”Ymmärsimme, että…”
content:
Teknologiajätti Google jätti keskiviikkona vastineensa Lupa- ja valvontavirastolle (LVV) yhtiön Muhoksella ja Kajaanissa tekemistä datakeskustyömaiden metsähakkuista.

Googlen datakeskushanketta varten tehty hakkuu Muhoksella aiemmin tänä vuonna tehtiin ilman ympäristövaikutusten arviointia (yva), vaikka Lupa- ja valvontavirasto oli toukokuussa todennut hakkuun vaativan yva-menettelyn.

Hakkuut Kajaanissa ja Muhoksella oli Googlen mukaan aloitettu maaliskuun alkupuolella. Vastineessaan LVV:lle Google taustoittaa hakkuita ja niiden valmistelua edeltävää prosessia kuitenkin niukasti.

Yhtiö sanoo katsoneensa, että Muhoksen ja Kajaanin hankealueiden hakkuut ja valmistelutyöt voitaisiin lainmukaisesti toteuttaa metsälain mukaisten metsänkäyttöilmoitusten sekä rakentamislain pykälän 109 perusteella yva-menettelyn ollessa vielä kesken.

- Käsityksemme perustui aktiivisiin keskusteluihin toimivaltaisten viranomaisten kanssa. Näiden johdosta me ja paikalliset suunnittelu- ja kaavoitusneuvonantajamme ymmärsimme, että näiden töiden lainmukaisuudesta ja sallittavuudesta vallitsi yhteisymmärrys, vastineessa sanotaan.

title: Can you guess today’s Wikipedia article in seven clues?
content:
Every day at midnight UTC, a new Wikipedia article goes into hiding. Your job is to find it.

WikiWhiz is a free daily guessing game I built on top of English Wikipedia and other sister projects. If you’ve played Wordle, the rhythm will feel familiar: one puzzle a day, same for everyone, and a result you can share with friends. The difference is the answer. Instead of a five-letter word, it is a Wikipedia article, and the clues come from the knowledge our communities have spent more than two decades building.

You start with one clue and a row of empty letter tiles showing the shape of the article’s title. There’s also a hint that tells you the number of words the answer has.

Type a guess into the tiles. Every guess must be the title of a real English Wikipedia article (random letters are not accepted). A wrong guess (or pass, if you can’t think of an answer) unlocks the next clue, up to seven in total. Each wrong guess also tells you two things:

  • How close the spelling is. A simple similarity score shows whether you are getting warmer or colder.

title: We’re Asking the Wisconsin Supreme Court to End Warrantless ALPR Searches
content:
Today, EFF joined the ACLU of Wisconsin in filing a petition to the Wisconsin Supreme Court, asking it to rule that the state’s constitution requires a warrant for retrospective searches of ALPR databases used by law enforcement in four cities: Milwaukee, Racine, Kenosha, and Green Bay. We represent a religious organization, the Wisconsin Council of Churches, as well as an individual pastor in Green Bay.

As the petition explains:

Right now, Automated License Plate Readers (“ALPRs”) are recording the movements of vast numbers of Wisconsin drivers as they seek medical care, attend 12-step recovery meetings, attend religious services, participate in protests, attend political meetings, and engage in many other private, sensitive activities. Law enforcement entities throughout Wisconsin collect, store, share, and aggregate this ALPR data. Then they search it, retrospectively tracking the movements of individuals and entire communities in ways that would have been prohibitively costly, if not outright impossible, before the advent of ALPR technology.
